title: Ember and Sigil Anew
author: Casper Nystrom
blurb: Vesper Fairweather, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
